executive_summary: Compare two price-search implementations from the same tested stage-3 mutation base. Freeze the schedule before either candidate is measured and keep all results, including slowdowns.
secondary_metric: simulation phase self-reported seconds; aggregate batch sub-simulations separately
correctness: Independent original-engine tests, exact dual-journal comparisons and unchanged developer gates for all selected units; 65-scenario public trace regression per implementation
reporting: Both per-unit medians, every timing sample, paired ratios and ranges; no selected best repeat, no official speedup/significance claim. No additional confirmation schedule unless a new failure or unresolved evidence needs it.

synthetic_diagnostics.order: AB/BA alternating; each container runs every case; one Docker slot
synthetic_diagnostics.metric: inside-process perf_counter_ns; initialization excluded and initial lookup metadata warmed; mutation/index maintenance included
synthetic_diagnostics.correctness: domain output SHA-256 equal for every case and pair
